features.name: Financial Reporting Usage Telemetry
features.description: Telemetry for tracking when users run financial reports on screen or from the request page, including report row and column definitions. Useful for auditing needs to know who is running financial reports.

features.name: Financial Reporting Definition Changes Telemetry
features.description: Telemetry tracking changes to financial reporting definitions including row definitions, column definitions, and report definitions. Captures lifecycle events such as created, modified, deleted, copied, imported, or exported using configuration packages.

features.name: Client Add-ins Exception Telemetry
features.description: New telemetry in the exceptions table for troubleshooting client add-ins. Captures exception details including environment, company, app, object, add-in name, assembly, error messages, and stack traces from JavaScript errors.
caveats: previously not tracked; focused on iframe-based add-ins

features.name: Server-side Certificate Validation Telemetry
features.description: Telemetry for HTTP client certificate validation performed by the AL runtime. Logs validation failures with details about the certificate, endpoint called, HTTP method used, and failure reason.

features.name: Deprecated SOAP Protocol Detection
features.description: Telemetry event RT0053 to detect if customers are calling UI pages via deprecated SOAP web services. Helps identify integrations that need to stop using SOAP before it is turned off in a later release.
caveats: only identifies which endpoint is called, not which integration is calling it; SOAP will be turned off in a later release
